content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To care for a miniature schnauzer puppy, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research breed-specific health predispositions (2 hours)
Step 2. Purchase high-quality puppy kibble (30 minutes)
Step 3. Buy a sturdy adjustable collar and leash (20 minutes)
Step 4. Schedule the first round of vaccinations (15 minutes)
Step 5. Socialize the puppy with a friendly older dog (1 hour)
Step 6. Set up a dedicated feeding station (15 minutes)
Step 7. Puppy-proof the living room and kitchen (3 hours)
Step 8. Register the puppy's microchip online (20 minutes)
Step 9. Purchase a comfortable, appropriately sized crate (40 minutes)
Step 10. Introduce the puppy to the grooming brush (10 minutes)
Step 11. Practice "sit" and "stay" commands (20 minutes)
Step 12. Fill out the veterinary health history form (15 minutes)
Step 13. Install a child-safety gate in the hallway (30 minutes)
Step 14. Bathe the puppy using tearless shampoo (30 minutes)
Step 15. Take a commemorative "gotcha day" photo (5 minutes)
Step 16. Research local certified dog trainers (1 hour)
Step 17. Schedule the first professional grooming appointment (10 minutes)
Step 18. Apply a monthly flea and tick preventative (5 minutes)
Step 19. Pick up the puppy from the breeder (4 hours)
Step 20. Introduce the puppy to its new bed (10 minutes)
Step 21. Set up a consistent potty break schedule (1 hour)
Step 22. Buy a variety of chew toys for teething (30 minutes)
Step 23. Prepare a travel kit for car rides (20 minutes)
Step 24. Clean and sanitize the puppy's toys (15 minutes)
Step 25. Establish a "quiet time" routine (2 hours)
Step 26. Buy a clicker for positive reinforcement training (10 minutes)
Step 27. Put on the puppy's identification tags (5 minutes)
Step 28. Buy a long-line leash for recall training (15 minutes)
Step 29. Buy a small harness for walks (20 minutes)
Step 30. Purchase a bag of soft training treats (15 minutes)
Step 31. Wipe the puppy's paws after a walk (5 minutes)
Step 32. Select a veterinarian near your home (1 hour)
Step 33. Purchase a grooming table (1 hour)
Step 34. Check the puppy's ears for redness (5 minutes)
Step 35. Read a book on Schnauzer temperament (3 hours)
Step 36. Call to confirm the vet appointment (5 minutes)
Step 37. Fill the water bowl with fresh water (2 minutes)
Step 38. Brush the puppy's coat to prevent matting (20 minutes)
Step 39. Buy a specialized slicker brush (15 minutes)
Step 40. Trim the puppy's nails carefully (15 minutes)
Step 41. Buy a toothbrush and dog-safe toothpaste (10 minutes)
Step 42. Clean the puppy's beard after eating (5 minutes)
Step 43. Place an order for heartworm medication (10 minutes)
Step 44. Take the puppy out for a midnight potty break (10 minutes)
Step 45. Find a local 24-hour emergency vet (30 minutes)
Step 46. Give the puppy a small dental chew (5 minutes)
Step 47. Set up a grooming area in the laundry room (30 minutes)
Step 48. Let the puppy explore the backyard (30 minutes)
Step 49. Buy a puppy-safe cooling mat (20 minutes)
Step 50. Practice walking on a loose lead (15 minutes)
Step 51. Buy a pet first-aid kit (25 minutes)
Step 52. Clear the puppy's "eye goop" with a damp cloth (5 minutes)
Step 53. Prepare a list of toxic foods to avoid (20 minutes)
Step 54. Introduce the puppy to a car crate (30 minutes)
Step 55. Reward the puppy for calm behavior (5 minutes)
Step 56. Research the best diet for Schnauzers (2 hours)
Step 57. Wash the puppy's bedding (1 hour)
Step 58. Buy a bitter spray to discourage chewing (10 minutes)
Step 59. Put away the puppy's toys for the night (10 minutes)
Step 60. Check the puppy for any lumps or bumps (10 minutes)
Step 61. Buy a specialized puppy playpen (45 minutes)
Step 62. Buy a durable rubber toy for mental stimulation (15 minutes)
Step 63. Hand-strip the puppy's wire coat (1 hour)
Step 64. Buy a poop bag dispenser for the leash (10 minutes)
Step 65. Order a custom name tag (15 minutes)
Step 66. Set up a pet insurance policy (45 minutes)
Step 67. Brush the puppy's teeth (10 minutes)
Step 68. Refill the treat pouch (5 minutes)
Step 69. Move breakable items to higher shelves (45 minutes)
Step 70. Dry the puppy thoroughly with a towel (15 minutes)
Step 71. Buy a digital pet scale (20 minutes)
Step 72. Check the puppy's weight (5 minutes)
Step 73. Take the puppy to a "puppy social" hour (1 hour)
Step 74. Scoop the waste from the yard (15 minutes)
Step 75. Buy a high-value treat like boiled chicken (20 minutes)
Step 76. Print out the vaccination records (10 minutes)
Step 77. Buy a training whistle (15 minutes)
Step 78. Complete a basic puppy ownership course (5 hours)
Step 79. Give the puppy a gentle ear massage (10 minutes)
Step 80. Watch a video on Schnauzer grooming techniques (30 minutes)
Step 81. Attach a bell to the door for potty signaling (10 minutes)
Step 82. Purchase a "puppy in training" vest (20 minutes)
Step 83. Introduce the puppy to a vacuum cleaner (15 minutes)
Step 84. Take the puppy for a short socialization walk (20 minutes)
Step 85. Teach the puppy the "leave it" command (20 minutes)
Step 86. Call a professional trainer for a consultation (20 minutes)
Step 87. Feed the puppy its evening meal (10 minutes)
Step 88. Play a game of "hide and seek" with treats (15 minutes)
Step 89. Introduce the puppy to different floor surfaces (30 minutes)
Step 90. Buy a specialized dog hair dryer (1 hour)
Step 91. Trim the hair around the puppy's paws (20 minutes)
Step 92. Create a budget for the puppy's first year (2 hours)
Step 93. Sanitize the grooming tools (15 minutes)
Step 94. Check the puppy's water level (2 minutes)
Step 95. Practice the "down" command (15 minutes)
Step 96. Buy a reflective collar for night walks (15 minutes)
Step 97. Join an online miniature schnauzer forum (30 minutes)
Step 98. Research local dog parks (30 minutes)
Step 99. Put on a calming pheromone collar (5 minutes)
Step 100. Say goodnight and tuck the puppy in (5 minutes)
